attempt: Autumn leaf bark placement through a native client PlaceBlockInteraction with only server entity creation and no authoritative cell acknowledgement.
reason_failed: User reported a second tilted visual and missing bark preview. Production read-only scan found two persisted attachments and zero ordinary leaf cells; therefore saved-entity counts alone cannot validate the client frame. An unacknowledged client-predicted block is a supported hypothesis, not a proven client-render cause.
environment: Windows Hytale 0.7.2; Zytale Buildings and Furnishment 1.12.2 carrying the previous 1.11.1 leaf implementation.
error_signature: User-visible extra tilted copy during trunk placement, absent in persisted block-cell scan.
conditions: Native client placement prediction combined with a custom server prop route
Previous integration tests checked saved entities and outgoing packets but did not observe client frames
workaround: 1.13.0 reconciles the native predicted cell, sends an authoritative cell packet and introduces a private bark preview. Native checks pass; real client confirmation remains pending.

sources.description: Native test results, production read-only scan, final dimensions, installation and explicit client-validation limits.
